title: My New Neighbour
description: A short text about a new family next door and their daily life.
instructions: Read the text about a new neighbour, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: A new family lives next to us now. Their name is Rossi. They came from Italy in May. Mr Rossi is a cook and Mrs Rossi is a nurse.
They have a son. His name is Leo and he is eight. Every morning, Leo walks to school with his dog, Max. After school, he plays football in the park.
Last Sunday, Mrs Rossi gave us a big cake. It was very tasty. My mum said, 'Thank you! Please come for dinner on Friday.' Now we are good friends.
On Friday, the Rossi family came to our house for dinner. They brought a big bowl of pasta. My dad made fish and potatoes. We sat at the table for three hours. Everyone talked and laughed a lot.
Leo cannot speak much English yet. He speaks Italian at home. At dinner, he taught me some Italian words. 'Ciao' means 'hello' and 'grazie' means 'thank you'. I taught him some English words too.
Now Leo and I walk to school together every morning. Max comes with us to the school gate. Then Mrs Rossi takes him home. Leo is in my class. We sit next to each other.
On Saturday, I played football with Leo in the park. He is very good. He scored three goals! Next month, Leo wants to visit Italy with his family. He says, 'You can come too!' I am very excited.
